enrichCompany.description: Also read the current employer's own public LinkedIn page for employee count, size range, industry, headquarters, address, founded year, followers, website, logo, description, slogan, type and specialties. Uses the actor's free public access path; one fetch per unique company per run.
enrichCompany.title: Enrich Current Company

includeStatusRows.description: Add one structured status row when a run returns no profiles or only some of the requested profiles (for example a 404 or a privacy-restricted profile). Turn off for a dataset of profile records only.
includeStatusRows.title: Include Status Rows

profileUrls.description: Public LinkedIn profile URLs (https://www.linkedin.com/in/username) or bare usernames. Full URLs, 'in/username' shorthand, regional subdomains and URLs with tracking parameters are all accepted.
profileUrls.title: Profile URLs or Usernames
